title: Verify qsi.2/qsi.3: does wolfSSL dispatch wc_HmacCopy/wc_ecc_copy through CryptoCb COPY?
description: qsi.2 and qsi.3 depend on wolfSSL dispatching HMAC and ECC copy operations through WC_ALGO_TYPE_COPY. Read wolfcrypt/src/hmac.c (wc_HmacCopy) and wolfcrypt/src/ecc.c (wc_ecc_copy) to determine: (1) Do they call wc_CryptoCb_Copy or equivalent? (2) If yes, with info->copy.algo=WC_ALGO_TYPE_HMAC / WC_ALGO_TYPE_PK? (3) If the port returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE, does wolfSSL fall back to XMEMCPY of the whole struct (which would alias devCtx)? Expected outcomes: (a) Confirmed reachable → qsi.2/qsi.3 priority stands. (b) Not dispatched through CryptoCb → downgrade qsi.2/qsi.3 to theoretical and note the wolfSSL version constraint in the issue.
